SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT TO_CHAR(KEY_1) AS LEGACY_PO_NO FROM KADT_KEP WHERE DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND KEY_5 in (' ','T') GROUP BY KEY_1
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'EFMC' AS BUYER, 'KA' AS SITE, ISNULL(B.TARGET,' ') AS PLANT, ISNULL(B.KEY_1,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_NO, ISNULL(B.KEY_2,' ') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ, ISNULL(A.STATUS,'D') AS STATUS, ISNULL(BUYER_ITEM_NO,' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, ISNULL(CURRENCY_CODE,' ') AS CURRENCY_CODE, ISNULL(UNIT_PRICE,0) AS UNIT_PRICE, ISNULL(GR_QTY,0) AS GR_QTY, ISNULL(GR_AMT,0) AS GR_AMT, ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO1, ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_SEQ1, ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_NO,' ')+'-'+ISNULL(LEGACY_PR_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_PR_NO, ISNULL(GR_DATE,' ') AS GR_DATE, ISNULL(GR_DATE,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_NO, ISNULL(LEGACY_GR_SEQ,' ') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ, ISNULL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK FROM KEP_IBGO_INFO_V A, KADT_KEP B WHERE B.DOC_NAME = 'GR' AND B.KEY_5 in (' ','T') AND B.TARGET *= A.DELY_TO_LOCATION AND B.KEY_1 *= A.LEGACY_PO_NO AND B.KEY_2 *= A.LEGACY_PO_SEQ AND B.KEY_4 *= A.LEGACY_GR_SEQ AND B.KEY_1 *= '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' ORDER BY KEY_1, CAST(KEY_2 AS INT), KEY_4
UPDATE PO_KEPTRXL SET KEY_5 = 'D', KEY_9 = GETDATE() WHERE 1=1 AND KEY_1 = '$G_RS.LEGACY_PO_NO$' AND KEY_5 in (' ','T') AND DOC_NAME = 'GR'
